task.title: IPOC intervention required — Weeks of parental benefits were processed and paid

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding recalculation registration number:

ul.li: If no, go to step 15.
If yes, go to step 17.

step.cmd: In SSA, starting from the main screen, assign a recalculation registration number as follows:

ul.li: Select Claims Preparation .
Select Registration — Recalculation - Initial .
Social Insurance Number: Type the SIN (do not press the Enter key).
Press the ESC key when the Annexes menu appears.
Close the RCM screen that appears.
Press the Enter key when the Renewability/Registration screen appears.

Pay HRCC: Type the Service Canada Centre (SCC) number as shown in the claim file in FTS. If the field is blank, enter the HRCC using one of the following codes:
Atlantic: 1121
Quebec: 2371
Ontario: 3515
Western: 4812
Service Unit: Type “01.”
Decision Type: Select Recalculation — Initial (should default to this choice).
Flag: Select Recalculation (should default to this choice).
Tentative Benefit Period Commence: The BPC is prefilled by SSA.
Do you want an Intake data screen?: Select No .
Press the Enter key.

step.cmd: In NWS, reassign the newly created CR WI to yourself.
Determine the COD to enter manually in SSA for the calculation as the most recent of the following dates:

ul.li: the date of a prior non-EI ERB claim;
if the BPC is March 15, 2020 and June 28, 2020: the BPC of the new claim – 68 weeks – any other QP extensions;
if the BPC is between July 5, 2020 and August 23, 2020: the BPC of the new claim – 76 weeks – any other QP extensions;
if the BPC is on or after August 30, 2020: the BPC of the new claim – 80 weeks – any other QP extensions.

step.cmd: In SSA, calculate the claim as usual, except for the following input requirements:

ul.li:
On the Coding Requirements screen, complete these fields as follows:
Subsequent or Manual BPC: Enter the date of the BPC for the parental claim.
Previously paid BPC: Enter the COD.

On the Extension of the qualifying/benefit period screen input the extension under reason Employment measures. The From date use the BPC – [# weeks of the QP extension] and the To date use the date BPC – 1.

On the Determination of Earnings screen, input the WP waiver as follows:
Waiting Period Waiver: Select Yes .
Use the information obtained on the Subsequent decision screens to help complete the MM06 below.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Click Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 20 - Benefit period commencement change .
Remarks line 1: Type “Convert to parental claim at BPC [XXXX].”

Remarks line 2 to 4: Type “M106 BPC [XXXX], CT [14 or 16], APW [XXXX], PSW [XXXX], ENT WKS [XX], Natural/Adoption [XXXX], INS HRS [XXXX], INS EARN [XXXXX], DIV WK [XX], COD [XXXX], ERN WK 1 [XXXX], Sex cd [5,6,7,8], LFA [XX], WP waived, WLI 3 NO-CR-CODE (if necessary).”
Remarks line 5: Enter your name and telephone number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select E - Non-fraud - Paid beyond termination .
Message: Select 67 - O/P established / write-off - Change in insurable employment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Click Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and change the registration flag as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Click Update .
